title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
死寂。楚家大厅内，落针可闻。所有人都以为自己听错了。楚皓说什么？他要退婚？一个废物，要退掉与天之骄女萧清雪的婚约？这是何等的荒谬！何等的滑天下之大稽！楚山河猛地从座位上站起，脸色铁青。“皓儿，你胡说什么！还不快给萧小姐和萧长老道歉！”他怒喝道，声音中带着一丝惊恐。萧家的怒火，楚家承受不起。萧云峰的脸色也瞬间阴沉下来。他双目微眯，寒光闪烁。“楚皓，你再说一遍？”恐怖的气息从他体内弥漫而出，笼罩整个大厅。一些修为较低的宾客，只觉呼吸困难，脸色苍白。萧清雪那双清冷的凤眸中，也终于泛起一丝波澜。她看着楚皓，眼神中充满了错愕与不解。这个在她眼中如同蝼蚁般的废物，竟敢当众退她的婚？是谁给他的勇气？楚皓无视了父亲的怒斥和萧云峰的威压。他再次重复，声音比之前更加响亮，更加坚定。“我说，我楚皓，要与你萧清雪，解除婚约！”他一字一句，清晰无比。这一下，所有人都听清楚了。楚皓，是真的要退婚！“疯了！这楚皓一定是疯了！”“放着天大的福缘不要，竟然主动退婚？”“他脑子被驴踢了吧！”宾客们议论纷纷，看向楚皓的眼神如同看一个白痴。楚山河气得浑身发抖。“逆子！逆子啊！”他指着楚皓，一句话也说不出来。萧云峰怒极反笑。“好好好！真是好得很！”“我萧家屹立大炎王朝数百年，还从未受过这等奇耻大辱！”“楚山河，这就是你楚家的待客之道？”

楚山河连忙躬身：“萧长老息怒，这逆子口不择言，我定会给萧家一个交代！”他说着，便要上前擒拿楚皓。楚皓却猛地后退一步，避开了楚山河的手。他目光灼灼，盯着萧清雪，嘴角勾起一抹邪魅的笑容。“萧清雪，我知道你天资卓越，容颜绝世，被誉为大炎明珠。”“所有人都觉得我楚皓配不上你。”“所有人都觉得这门婚事，是我楚家高攀了你萧家。”他的声音回荡在大厅。萧清雪秀眉紧蹙，冷声道：“楚皓，你到底想说什么？”她心中升起一股莫名的烦躁。眼前的楚皓，让她感到陌生，也让她感到一丝…危险。楚皓深吸一口气。来了！系统任务的关键时刻！他猛地从怀中掏出一纸婚书。那是楚家与萧家当年定下的婚约。在众人惊骇的目光中，楚皓双手用力。“嗤啦——”婚书被他撕成两半！然后，又撕成了碎片！他随手一扬，碎纸纷飞，如同嘲弄的雪花。“我不退婚，难道还要等着你萧家来施舍吗？”楚皓朗声道，声音中充满了不屑与张狂。“你萧清雪，确实是天之骄女。”“但那又如何？”他一步踏前，气势逼人。“三十年河东，三十年河西，莫欺少年穷！”这句经典台词，从他口中吼出，带着一股莫名的震撼力。大厅内，许多年轻俊彦闻言，竟不由自主地热血上涌。萧清雪的娇躯微微一颤。她看着楚皓，眼神复杂。楚皓却没有停下。他指着萧清雪，一字一顿，声音如雷。“而你，萧清雪，今日还配不上我楚皓！”轰！这句话，如同一道惊雷，在所有人耳边炸响。配不上？楚皓竟然说，萧清雪配不上他？这已经不是狂妄了。这是赤裸裸的羞辱！
content_en:
Dead silence.In the Chu family hall, you can hear a needle drop.Everyone thought they heard wrong.What did Chu Hao say?He wants to break off the engagement?A good-for-nothing wants to cancel his engagement with Xiao Qingxue, the proud daughter of heaven?How ridiculous!What an outrageous thing!Chu Shanhe suddenly stood up from his seat, his face ashen."Hao'er, what nonsense are you talking about! Why don't you apologize to Miss Xiao and Elder Xiao quickly!" He shouted angrily, with a hint of panic in his voice.The Chu family cannot bear the Xiao family's anger.Xiao Yunfeng's face instantly darkened.His eyes narrowed slightly, with a cold light flashing."Chu Hao, can you say it again?" A terrifying aura filled the air from his body and enveloped the entire hall.Some guests with lower cultivation levels only found it difficult to breathe and looked pale.Xiao Qingxue's cold phoenix eyes finally had a trace of emotion.She looked at Chu Hao, her eyes full of surprise and confusion.How dare this person, who was as useless as an ant in her eyes, break off her engagement in public?Who gave him the courage?Chu Hao ignored his father's anger and Xiao Yunfeng's pressure.He repeated again, louder and more determined than before."I said, I, Chu Hao, want to break off my engagement with you, Xiao Qingxue!" He spoke every word clearly.This time, everyone heard clearly.Chu Hao really wants to break off the engagement!"Crazy! This Chu Hao must be crazy!" "He actually broke off the engagement regardless of his huge fortune?" "He must have been kicked in the head by a donkey!" The guests talked incessantly and looked at Chu Hao as if they were an idiot.Chu Shanhe was so angry that he was shaking all over."You traitor! You traitor!" He pointed at Chu Hao, unable to say a word.Xiao Yunfeng laughed in anger."Okay, okay! It's really good!" "My Xiao family has been standing in the Great Yan Dynasty for hundreds of years, and I have never suffered such a shame and humiliation!" "Chu Shanhe, is this the way your Chu family treats guests?"

Chu Shanhe hurriedly bowed: "Elder Xiao, calm down, this traitor is talking nonsense, I will give the Xiao family an explanation!" As he said this, he was about to step forward to capture Chu Hao.Chu Hao took a step back suddenly, avoiding Chu Shanhe's hand.He stared at Xiao Qingxue with burning eyes, and an evil smile appeared at the corner of his mouth."Xiao Qingxue, I know that you have outstanding talents and peerless appearance, and are known as the Pearl of the Great Flame." "Everyone thinks that I, Chu Hao, am not worthy of you." "Everyone thinks that this marriage is because my Chu family has surpassed your Xiao family." His voice echoed in the hall.Xiao Qingxue frowned and said coldly: "Chu Hao, what exactly do you want to say?" An inexplicable irritation rose in her heart.The Chu Hao in front of her felt strange to her, and also made her feel a little...dangerous.Chu Hao took a deep breath.Coming!A critical moment for the system mission!He suddenly took out a marriage certificate from his arms.That was the marriage contract made by the Chu family and the Xiao family back then.In the horrified eyes of everyone, Chu Hao used both hands hard."Tsk-" The marriage document was torn into two halves by him!Then, it was torn into pieces again!He raised his hand casually, and pieces of paper flew like mocking snowflakes."If I don't break off the engagement, am I going to have to wait for the Xiao family to give me alms?" Chu Hao said loudly, his voice full of disdain and arrogance."You, Xiao Qingxue, are indeed the proud daughter of heaven." "But so what?" He stepped forward with a compelling momentum."Thirty years in Hedong, thirty years in Hexi, don't bully young people into poverty!" This classic line roared from his mouth, with an inexplicable shock.In the hall, many young men and women could not help but feel excited after hearing this.Xiao Qingxue's delicate body trembled slightly.She looked at Chu Hao with complicated eyes.Chu Hao did not stop.He pointed at Xiao Qingxue and spoke every word with a voice like thunder."And you, Xiao Qingxue, are not worthy of me, Chu Hao, today!" Boom!These words were like thunder, exploding in everyone's ears.Not worthy?Chu Hao actually said that Xiao Qingxue was not worthy of him?This is no longer arrogance.This is naked humiliation!
